name: Elder Bronzebeard
summary: During the Lunar Festival, Elder Bronzebeard appears in Ironforge's Mystic Ward. His name is the name of the clan that rules the city, and his earthen form recalls the dwarves' stone-born ancestors.

sections.title: A Progenitor in the Mystic Ward
sections.body:
Near the pool in Ironforge's Mystic Ward, Elder Bronzebeard appears in the shape of an earthen. The Titans forged the ancient earthen from living stone before they became creatures of flesh. Dwarven scholars and explorers are only beginning to uncover their origins through excavations across Khaz Modan and beyond.

Elder Bronzebeard bears the name of the ruling clan, and his form suggests he is a direct ancestor of the Bronzebeards. His spirit shows how far his stone-born descendants have changed.

faq.q: Why does Elder Bronzebeard look like an earthen instead of a regular dwarf?
faq.answer: Dwarves descend from the earthen, ancient beings the Titans crafted from stone. Over time, the earthen became creatures of flesh. Elder Bronzebeard lived in the distant past, before that change took hold, and his spirit keeps the stony shape of his earthen days.

faq.q: Is he related to King Magni Bronzebeard?
faq.answer: His name and presence in Ironforge point to a revered ancestor of the Bronzebeard clan, the line that rules the city under King Magni. The exact branches of ancient family trees are lost to history.

faq.q: Why is Elder Bronzebeard in Ironforge?
aliases: what is elder bronzebeard doing here
faq.answer: During the Lunar Festival, elder spirits appear throughout Azeroth to share wisdom and blessings with travelers. Elder Bronzebeard appears near the tranquil pool in Ironforge's Mystic Ward, where dwarven mages and scholars gather.

angles.text: As a dwarf, meeting Elder Bronzebeard offers a rare glimpse of your earthen ancestry. The Explorers' League is uncovering more through its research.
As an Alliance pilgrim in Ironforge during the Lunar Festival, you can meet an elder who represents the foundations of the dwarven kingdom.
